name: NURS 5012
title: Nursing Science and Patterns of Knowing in Advanced Nursing Practice
description: An historical, contemporary and futuristic exploration of the art and science of nursing praxis including patterns of knowing: empirical, ethical, aesthetic, existential and emancipatory. Theories and models derived from nursing and the social sciences are synthesized for their usefulness in advanced practice nursing care for individuals, families, and communities to promote health and manage a variety of problems such as health threats, acute and chronic illnesses, and transitions. Opportunities are provided for students to synthesize family health concepts for use in clinical practice, scholarship, and research.
requirement_description: NURS Grad Majors; open to graduate students in other disciplines with instructor consent.
